properties.name: gp.agent.storage
properties.description: Backing store for chat memory. Accepted values: postgres, file (default).

properties.name: gp.agent.memory.max-messages
properties.description: Maximum number of messages kept per session window (MessageWindowChatMemory). Tool-call intermediates are compacted before this limit is applied. Default: 20.

properties.name: gp.agent.memory.max-output-tokens
properties.description: Maximum tokens the model may produce in a single response (maps to maxTokens on OpenAI/Anthropic, numPredict on Ollama). Default: 4096.
